definition: the soft white grease in meat
description: On an old gas cooker by a sunny kitchen window, a thick slab of pork belly with a wide white layer of fat sizzles in a black cast-iron pan full of bubbling melted fat. Drops spit into the air, and melted fat runs over the rim of the pan and drips down past the blue flame. A bowl of solid white lard sits beside the stove, and another raw slab of pork belly lies on a wooden board with salt and a cleaver. Wooden spoons stand in a jar against the tiles.

taps.phrase: to rest on a chopping board
